mapper.select: /* User05Mapper.selectDailyContractSignHis */ SELECT S.SIGN_ID AS signId , S.CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , C.CONTRACT_NM AS contractNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.SIGN_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS signDtime , S.FIRST_WORK_DATE AS firstWorkDate , S.REQ_ID AS reqId FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT_SIGN S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_CONTRACT C ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND S.CONTRACT_VER = C.CONTRACT_VER ) WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.USER_CD = #{userCd} ORDER BY S.SIGN_DTIME DESC LIMIT 200

/* User05Mapper.selectDailyEntryHis */ SELECT R.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , DATE_FORMAT(R.REQ_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reqDtime , DATE_FORMAT(R.PROC_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS procDtime , DATE_FORMAT(R.CONSUME_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS consumeDtime , R.CONTRACT_VER AS contractVer , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_DAILY_CONTRACT_SIGN S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND S.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS signYn FROM TB_DAILY_ENTRY_REQUEST R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} ORDER BY R.REQ_DTIME DESC LIMIT 200
